TOUHOUANCIENTS-LUCKY_RABBIT.title: Lucky Rabbit
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LUCKY_RABBIT.description: Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Randomize the cost of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn, and add [gold]Replay[/gold] this combat to those that cost [blue]0[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SATORI_EYE.title: Eye of Satori
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SATORI_EYE.description:
[gold]Scry[/gold] [blue]{SatoriScry}[/blue].
Return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Increase this card's cost this turn by {Energy:energyIcons()}.
[purple][jitter]Now the real climax begins![/jitter][/purple]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TRIBUTE.title: Tribute
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TRIBUTE.description:
Removed from your [gold]Deck[/gold] after accumulating [blue]{Remaining}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] in tribute.
[fade_in]I'm adorable, give me money![/fade_in]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_SEAL.title: Dream Seal
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_SEAL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage [blue]6[/blue] times to ALL enemies.
If the enemy intends to attack, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and reduce its [gold]Strength[/gold] by {StrengthLoss:diff()} this turn.
[b]Extermination, decided.[/b]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_SAKUYA.title: Time Minion
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_SAKUYA.descriptio:
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Shiv[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
At the end of turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to the target for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_PATCHOULI.title: Magic Minion
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_PATCHOULI.descrip:
Add [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to all non-Minion cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Add {Cards} [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_HONGMEILING.title: Qi Minion
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_HONGMEILING.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This turn, convert half of the attack damage you blocked into [gold]Vigor[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ALL_CREATION_HISOU.title: All Creation's Hisou
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ALL_CREATION_HISOU.descri:
{IfUpgraded:show:Upgrade, |}Play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Hand and Exhaust Pile[/gold].
[red]The sky's weather, the earth's stability, the heart of people—all within my grasp![/red]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ALL_CREATION_HISOU_OLD.de:
本场战斗所有队友已拥有与之后获得的[gold]正面效果[/gold]层数增加[blue]1[/blue]。
所有队友获得{Energy:energyIcons()}、{singleStarIcon}。抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。[gold]铸造[/gold][blue]9[/blue]。[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]5[/blue]。获得[blue]1[/blue][gold]力量[/gold]、[blue]1[/blue][gold]敏捷[/gold]、[blue]1[/blue][gold]集中[/gold]。
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MAGIC_WALLET.title: Magic Mallet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MAGIC_WALLET.description:
Your next [blue]{CurrentFreeCount}[/blue] other cards are free to play.
After each play, cost increases by {Energy:energyIcons()} and free uses increase by [blue]1[/blue].
[purple][sine]Sound a Requiem for the Revolutionaries![/sine][/purple]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LILY_BELL.title: Lily Bell
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LILY_BELL.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards. Apply [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies equal to {Multiplier:diff()}x your [purple]Tainted[/purple] count{InCombat: ([green]{CalculatePoison}[/green])|}.
Each time this card is drawn or played, this card is [gold]Afflicted with[/gold] [purple]Tainted[/purple] [blue]{ExtraAmount}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LIFE_MUST_PERISH.title: All Living Things Must Perish
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LIFE_MUST_PERISH.descript:
After {Countdown:inverseDiff()} turns, remove all [gold]Artifact[/gold] from enemies and apply [blue]9999[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to ALL enemies.
When you receive attack damage, extend the countdown by [blue]1[/blue] turn and apply [blue]{SelfDoom}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KONSHII_NO_KUSURI_CARD.de:
When your HP would drop to [blue]0[/blue] or below, if this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], discard it and heal [green]{HealPercent}%[/green] HP, gain [pink]Impurity[/pink] count, and lose [blue]{BaseMaxHpLoss}[/blue] × [pink]Impurity[/pink] count Max HP.{InCombat:
(Lose [red]{ShouldLose}[/red] Max HP)|}
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MASTER_SPARK.title: Master Spark
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MASTER_SPARK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X+{ExtraHit} times to ALL enemies.
{IfUpgraded:show:Triple|Double} X and gain {Energy:energyIcons()} if it's {Need:diff()} or more.
[gold]The most important thing about danmaku is firepower [sine]Da☆Ze[/sine]！[/gold]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SEA_OPENING_MIRACLE.title: Miracle of the Sea Opening
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SEA_OPENING_MIRACLE.descr: Deal damage equal to half of each enemy's current HP to ALL enemies.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_KOISHI_EYE.title: Closed Eye
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_KOISHI_EYE.descriptio:
Randomly play {Cards:diff()} cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold], and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
[gold]Enchant[/gold] a random Attack among them with [purple]Instinct[/purple]. Gain [red]Unconscious[/red] on a random card among them.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KILLING_AURA.title: Killing Lunacy
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KILLING_AURA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you play a card with Attack or Block, if this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it and add those values{IfUpgraded:show: plus [blue]1[/blue]|} to this card.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURE_HELL_OF_BULLETS.desc:
Choose any number of cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Transform[/gold] them into [gold]Nameless Bullets[/gold].
This turn, your Attack cards are free to play and draw a card when played. When you have no Attack cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], end your turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NAMELESS_BULLETS.title: Nameless Bullets
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RICHEST_FORM.title: 极奢形态
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RICHEST_FORM.description:
获得[blue]{StartingCapital:diff()}[/blue]点[gold]启动资金[/gold]。
打出非X费牌不再消耗能量，改为以[blue]1:10[/blue]的比例消耗[gold]启动资金[/gold]，[gold]启动资金[/gold]不足时改为消耗等量[gold]金币[/gold]。
TOUHOUANCIENTS-POOREST_FORM.title: 至贫形态
TOUHOUANCIENTS-POOREST_FORM.description:
打出耗能为[blue]0[/blue]的牌或以[blue]0[/blue]能量结束回合时，给予随机一个敌人随机一种状态：
[blue]1[/blue]层[gold]虚弱[/gold] / [blue]1[/blue]层[gold]易伤[/gold] / [blue]3[/blue]层[gold]中毒[/gold] / [blue]8[/blue]层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_FEAST.title: The Feast
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_FEAST.description:
Select and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] {MinExhaust}~{MaxExhaust} cards that aren't [gold]The Feast[/gold] from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. For each, gain {Strength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {Energy:energyIcons()}.
At end of turn, if this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], add {Copies} copies of this card to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
